# {k} is replaced by each keyword followed by a type suffix.
=== asvalue bas
Sub P()
x = {k}
End Sub
=== asstmt bas
Sub P()
{k}
End Sub
=== asstmtarg bas
Sub P()
{k} 1
End Sub
=== asassign bas
Sub P()
{k} = 1
End Sub
=== asdecl bas
Sub P()
Dim {k} As Long
End Sub
=== asmember bas
Sub P(o As Object)
x = o.{k}
End Sub
